contract.intent: Prepare the immutable execution context for Drift contract checks while preserving the boundary between scoped execution and global proof context.

must_not_change: helperContracts must use import-candidate lookups, not full store materialization.
changedOnly must include changed contracts and SSOT-impacted contracts.
Extraction must use Git-scoped files when a Git base is provided.
SourceCache must be instantiated per check run, not globally.
